newsitem.title: USA: Intl CableTel completes notes offering.
newsitem.headline: Intl CableTel completes notes offering.

text.p: International CableTel Inc Wednesday said it raised $400 million of gross proceeds from a recent offering of senior notes due 2007 and raised $100 million of gross proceeds for preferred Stock with a maturity in 2009, in a concurrent offering.
The notes carry a cash-pay current coupon, while the preferred stock carries either a cash-pay or pay-in-kind dividend at the option of the company during the first seven years.
The use of proceeds of the offering will be for the construction, working capital requirements and other corporate purposes of the company, it said.
